note: Edits to the OSM layout for Wannamoisett. Built into edited/course.geojson by pipeline/merge_edits.py (run by make course).

add.reason: OSM maps no golf=pin; one pin at the centre of each green (data/wannamoisett/propose_pins.py), as at Highland Links and Indian Island

the clubhouse is mapped golf=clubhouse + building=yes and s01 reads the golf key first, so it was not a building; its OSM outline is added unchanged as a building (data/wannamoisett/propose_buildings.py) so it is drawn and gives obstruction relief

tags.reason: pond beside hole 14: red penalty area (developer, 2026-10-19). OSM has it as an inner ring of the course relation; config join_boundary brings it inside the boundary
pond crossed by the lines of holes 1 and 9: red penalty area (developer, 2026-10-19: all penalty areas red)
